name: Ginger Glow Oil Cleanser
desc: A melting oil cleanser with ginger and botanical extracts that dissolves sunscreen and makeup without stripping.
how: Massage onto dry skin, add water to emulsify, rinse. Use as the first step of your evening double cleanse.

name: Green Tangerine Jam Cleanser
desc: A fresh, vitamin-rich gel cleanser with green tangerine that clears excess oil and leaves skin bright.
how: Lather a small amount with water, massage for 30 seconds, rinse well. Morning and night.

name: Ginseng Hydrating Foam Wash
desc: A soft pump foam with ginseng that cleans gently and keeps the moisture barrier comfortable.
how: Pump one or two times onto damp skin, massage, rinse. Morning and night.

name: Peach Niacinamide Serum
desc: A lightweight peach-infused serum with niacinamide to refine pores, even tone and control shine.
how: Apply 3-4 drops on clean skin before moisturiser. Morning and night. Always follow with SPF in the day.

name: Berry Repose Soothing Serum
desc: A cooling, moisturising serum that calms visible redness and softens the look of fine lines.
how: Smooth a few drops over face and neck after toner. Pat in gently.

name: Teal Renew Night Cream
desc: A rich, cushiony renewal cream that plumps and restores skin while you sleep.
how: Warm a pea-sized amount between fingers and press over face and neck at night.

name: Blush Barrier Cream
desc: A soft pink whipped moisturiser that strengthens the skin barrier and locks in hydration all day.
how: Apply to face morning and night after serum.

name: Sunday Mineral Sunscreen SPF 40
desc: A daily mineral sunscreen with broad-spectrum SPF 40 that sits light on the skin.
how: Apply two finger-lengths to face and neck as the last step of your morning routine. Reapply every 2-3 hours outdoors.

name: Coconut Classic SPF 50 Lotion
desc: A water-resistant broad-spectrum SPF 50 lotion with coconut and aloe vera for beach and body days.
how: Apply generously 15 minutes before sun exposure and reapply after swimming.

name: Peptide Lip Tint Trio
desc: Three sheer, buildable tints with peptides that condition lips while adding colour.

name: Sunny Peptide Lip Balm
desc: A glossy, softening lip treatment in a squeezable tube for everyday comfort.

name: Lavender Caviar Sheet Mask
desc: A deeply nourishing sheet mask that revitalises tired, dull skin in 15 minutes.

name: Fruit Series Hydrating Mask Set
desc: Playful fruit-extract sheet masks — pomegranate, honey and more — for a weekly hydration boost.

name: Pineapple Glow Body Scrub
desc: A juicy exfoliating scrub with pineapple that buffs away dead skin for a smooth glow.

name: Peach Sugar Body Scrub
desc: A creamy sugar scrub with peach that exfoliates while leaving skin soft and nourished.

name: Lemon Enzyme Powder Cleanser
desc: A gentle enzyme powder with lemon peel and papain that lifts dead skin and brightens.
how: Mix a pea-sized amount with water in wet hands, lather and massage for 30 seconds, then rinse.

name: Purifying Foaming Gel Cleanser
desc: A clear foaming gel that removes excess oil and impurities without leaving skin tight.
how: Massage onto wet skin, rinse well. Morning and night.

name: Centella Calm Toner
desc: A soothing centella and green tea toner that purifies and calms visible redness.
how: Apply to a cotton pad or press into skin with clean hands after cleansing.

name: Orange Radiance Essence Toner
desc: A hydrating essence toner with peptides, niacinamide and hyaluronate for a lit-from-within glow.
how: Pat 2-3 layers into clean skin before serum.

name: Cherry Peptide Lip Tint
desc: A juicy red peptide lip tint that conditions while it colours.
how: Swipe on lips whenever you need colour and comfort.

name: Blueberry Glow Lip Balm
desc: A glossy blueberry lip balm that leaves lips soft and bouncy.
how: Apply throughout the day.

name: Honey Glow Lip Oil
desc: A shimmering honey-infused lip oil for a plush, glassy finish.
how: Glide over bare lips or over lip colour.

name: Green Tea Cica Gel Mask
desc: A hydrogel collagen mask with green tea and cica that soothes and cares for pores.
how: Apply on clean skin for 20 minutes, remove and pat in the essence.

name: Pink Vanilla Lip Sleeping Mask
desc: An overnight lip mask that melts into lips for soft, smooth mornings.
how: Apply a thick layer before bed and wipe off in the morning.

name: Blue Clay Purifying Mask
desc: A creamy blue clay mask that purifies pores and mattifies oily skin.
how: Apply an even layer, leave for 10 minutes, rinse with lukewarm water. Use 1-2 times a week.

name: Cotton Candy Lip Sleeping Mask
desc: A cotton-candy scented overnight lip mask for plump, hydrated lips.
how: Apply before bed as the last step of your routine.

name: Rosy Glow Cream
desc: A luminous cream in a berry jar that hydrates and adds a soft glow.
how: Smooth over face and neck morning and night.

name: Barely There Lightweight Moisturiser
desc: A weightless pump moisturiser that hydrates without feeling heavy or greasy.
how: One or two pumps on clean skin, morning and night.

name: Grape Seed Body Polish
desc: A soft polishing body scrub with grape seed that smooths and softens skin.
how: Massage onto damp skin in circular motions, then rinse.

name: Vitamin C Brightening Serum
desc: A multi-vitamin serum with vitamin C that brightens and evens skin tone.
how: Apply 3-4 drops in the morning before moisturiser and SPF.

name: Rose Quartz Roller & Gua Sha Set
desc: A cooling rose quartz face roller and heart-shaped gua sha for sculpting massage and a calmer, glowier complexion.
how: Apply serum or oil, then roll or glide upward and outward over face and neck for 3-5 minutes.
